result.topic_en: The page gives the multinomial expansion of a power of a series in powers of x, and then the Lagrange series (inversion theorem) for a function of x defined by x = t + uX.
result.transcription:
$\left(x^m + (1)x^{m+\delta} + (2)x^{m+2\delta} + (3)x^{m+3\delta} \ldots\ldots\right)^t$
$= x^{mt} \times \Sigma\, x^{s\delta} \frac{t.t-1\ldots.t-n+1}{1\ldots(I).1\ldots(II).(1\ldots.III)\ldots.} (1)^{(I)}(2)^{(II)}(3)^{(III)}\cdots$
si $(I) + 2(II) + 3(III)\ldots. = s$
$(I) + (II) + (III)\ldots.. = n$

$x = t + UX$
$\varphi x = \varphi x + uA' + \frac{uu}{1.2}A'' + \frac{u^3}{1.2.3}A''' \ldots\ldots$
$A' = \frac{dU}{du} . X \frac{d\varphi x}{dt}$
$A'' = \frac{d^2U}{2.du^2} X \frac{\partial\varphi x}{dt} + \frac{d^2U^2}{2du^2}\frac{\partial XX\frac{d\varphi x}{dt}}{dt}$
$A''' = \frac{d^3.U^{[?]}}{[-\ldots-] du^3} X\frac{d\varphi x}{dt} + \frac{d^3.UU}{2.du^3}\frac{\partial XX\frac{\partial\varphi x}{\partial t}}{\partial t}$
$+ \frac{d^3U^3}{2.3du^3}\frac{\partial^2 X^3\frac{\partial\varphi x}{\partial t}}{\partial t^2}$

folglich
$\varphi x = \phi x + UX\frac{d\phi x}{dt} + \frac{UU}{1.2}\frac{\partial.XX\frac{\partial\varphi x}{\partial t}}{\partial t} + \frac{U^3}{1.2.3}\frac{\partial\partial X^3\frac{\partial\varphi x}{dt}}{dt^2}$
Die gewöhnliche Form des Lehrsatzes
